name: Conventions Extractor — accept/reject/edit the seeded candidates, then create a skill
description: Cannot run extract in e2e (no LLM key, no clone — specs/conventions-extractor.md §9); the seed instead adds one scan + 3 pending candidates on acme/payments-api (highest-confidence first: error-handling, imports, naming). This flow edits the first candidate then rejects it (collapses to one line with Undo), accepts the second (toolbar count updates, Create skill appears — C16), opens Create skill (prefilled from skill-draft, C14) and submits without attaching an agent, then confirms the new `repo-conventions` skill is visible on /skills. Agent attach + the deep-link to the agent's Skills tab (C13) is covered by CreateSkillModal.test.tsx and manual QA instead — a checkbox click inside the modal's scrollable agent list proved flaky under CI's headless renderer. Creates real data — run last, and only against the hermetic stack (a fresh DB per run).
